frame.assumptions: No second deployment model exists yet to test the new resolution against for real. A passing test suite plus confirming both paths still resolve to this repository's real openspec/ and ledger/ directories is sufficient evidence.
frame.goal: Fix the __file__-derived path assumption in protocol/backlog.py's VOCABULARY_SPEC and runtime/spend.py's SPEND_LOG. Both use Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] to walk up to the repo root, which silently breaks if yosefactory is ever installed apart from its own source checkout.
frame.method: Read both modules' existing docstrings in full first. Replace the fixed parents[3] walk at both call sites with a mechanism that does not assume a fixed directory depth -- for example walking upward from __file__ until a marker file (pyproject.toml or .git) is found. Apply the same fix to both call sites. Keep `pytest -q` green.
